page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.12xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369HB processors running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. With a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, each of the 48 vCPUs maps directly to a dedicated physical core, eliminating resource contention from hyperthreading.

The instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. It does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a resource density perspective, the dedicated core allocation and high memory capacity position this instance for memory-intensive workloads that require predictable CPU performance. The lack of bundled local storage and GPUs makes it a cost-efficient option for workloads focused purely on memory capacity and processing power, such as in-memory databases, large-scale caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and memory-bound data processing pipelines.
